name: io.web3alert/agent
title: Web3alert for agents
description: Decoded on-chain events for AI agents: wallet sign-up, USDC top-ups, webhooks or an inbox.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Create an agent key on the Agents page (https://web3alert.io/agents) and send Authorization: Bearer <key> for tool calls. Listing tools works without it. An agent can also get a key on its own by signing in with an Ethereum wallet; see https://web3alert.io/llms.txt.
